emitted_surface.command: actinv export-source alara R2S_SOURCE.ndjson OUT_DIR --shutdown-t-s T
emitted_surface.format: one ALARA .photonSrc file per cell (TOTAL\t<time>\t<densities...>, tab-separated) under OUT_DIR, plus a provenance index OUT_DIR/actinv-alara-index.json carrying the group centroid grid and per-cell sigma
emitted_surface.consumers_verified: nucleide 0.16.0 (own ALARA photon-source reader + r2s zone-tagging API) and an independently applied PyNE photon_source_to_hdf5 splitting/indexing rule; PyNE itself not installed

limits: TOTAL rows only — actinv-r2s-source-1 carries per-cell photon totals, not per-nuclide group spectra; per-nuclide ALARA rows are a separate protocol
centroid grid, not energy bounds — the user writes the matching ALARA photon_source bin bounds from the index's group_centroids_eV
verification is by the consumers' own parsers (nucleide) and an independently applied PyNE rule, not by running ALARA or a transport code
nucleide is pre-alpha; the round-trip is pinned to 0.16.0 — later versions are a re-run, not a claim
